title: pxsig workspace (pxsig.workspace.json)
description: Lists the projects in a repository. Lives at the repository root.

projects.description: Project name to project folder, relative to the workspace root. Each folder holds a pxsig.config.json.

defaults.description: Project config keys applied under each project's own config. Paths here resolve relative to each project folder; use "$workspace/" for shared paths.

requires.description: The pxsig versions this workspace needs, as a range (">=0.4.0", ">=0.4.0 <0.6.0"; || between alternatives). A pxsig outside it refuses to run here (pxsig 0.3.x does not read this key).

port.description: Port pxsig serve tries first; the next ten are tried if it is taken.
